'''Elkan Danneer''' was a member of the [[Tourism Council of Oluna Biqua]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Danneer invited the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to [[Oluna Biqua]], to stay at the newly built luxury [[Casino/Legends|casino]] and resort [[Night Imperial]].
